clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Mulgore, Venture Co. Documents confirm illegal strip-mining in tauren lands. The papers were recovered from a crate amid a ruined caravan and detail the company's operations.

Venture Co. Documents were found atop mined ore in a ransacked wagon. The ledgers show the goblin-led cartel has quietly established drilling and mining outposts in Mulgore's eastern foothills. Across Kalimdor, the Venture Company is known for ruthless deforestation and uncontrolled excavation. Morin Cloudstalker and the tauren Outrunners use the seized records to judge the threat to their sacred ancestral plains and rally hunters to drive out the trespassers.
